label: Permitted image directory
help: Only local files below this directory. Empty uses the application root; no URLs or symbolic links.

label: Default camera ID
help: Used for plain paths. JSON frames can specify source_id to keep cameras separate.

label: Model size
help: Nano is smallest; Fast is the default; Max is larger and slower. Weights are pinned to ORTUS 1.0.0.

label: Execution device
help: CPU uses INT8. CUDA requires a working ONNX Runtime GPU installation; no silent CPU fallback.

label: Download missing weights
help: First frame only; no download during Run preparation. Verified weights stay in this node’s cache. Images never leave the server.

label: Minimum confidence
help: Reject low-confidence estimates, in addition to the model’s calibrated abstention policy.

label: Model abstention policy
help: Standard uses the tier’s calibrated threshold. Strict may reject more ambiguous images.

label: Smoothing window (frames)
help: Circular mean of accepted frames per source. The first full window defines the Run’s reference angle.

label: Change threshold (degrees)
help: Emit rotated when drift reaches this threshold; returned below half. No repeated alert while still drifted.

label: Minimum interval per camera (ms)
help: During Active Runtime, only the latest pending frame per camera is retained. This does not configure the camera.

label: Maximum frame age (ms)
help: Drop stale frames/results. Prepare the offline cache before a live stream to avoid first-download delay.

label: Reset reference after inactivity (s)
help: Start a new warm-up after this time without an accepted estimate. Tracking is not persisted across Runs.

label: Maximum cameras per Run
help: Bound per-source state and pending frames; additional source IDs are dropped until the next Run.

label: Maximum input bytes
help: Reject oversized files before image decoding; default 10 MiB.

label: Maximum decoded pixels
help: JPEG, PNG, WebP, TIFF or BMP; one frame only, with EXIF orientation applied.

label: CPU inference threads
help: Bound ONNX intra-operation parallelism. One owned model process per active node.

label: Frame processing deadline (s)
help: Stop cancels the owned process. Invalid frames report an error without intentionally failing the whole Run.

label: First model loading allowance (s)
help: Additional time for the first load/download. Checksum failures are refused, never silently repaired.
